0022600139.text: The Minnesota Timberwolves, 3-0 and third in the Northwest, host the Golden State Warriors, who are 0-3, 14th in the West, and on a three-game losing streak. Minnesota is without Donte DiVincenzo (Achilles, surgery), while Golden State is missing Jimmy Butler III (knee, surgery), Kristaps Porzingis (illness) and Moses Moody (knee, surgery). The teams have not met yet this season, and Minnesota won the 2025-26 season series 3-1, including a 127-117 victory in San Francisco on March 13, 2026.
